content.title: MLB The Show 26 Release Date and Early Access Start Times
content.text: The launch of MLB The Show 26 is getting closer, and many players are already planning their first games in Diamond Dynasty, Road to the Show, or Franchise Mode. For those who want to start playing before the official release, the game also offers an early access period.How to Get MLB The Show 26 Early AccessPlayers who want to jump into the game before the official launch will need to pre-order the Deluxe Edition. Early access is not available with the Standard Edition.The Deluxe Edition costs $99.99 and includes several bonus items along with the early access period.To unlock early access, players simply need to pre-order the Deluxe Edition through the official store page.Steps to pre-order and access the game early:Visit the MLB The Show website.Select the Pre-Order Now option.Choose the Deluxe Edition.Pick the preferred platform:PlayStation 5Xbox Series X|SNintendo SwitchContinue to the retailer page and complete the purchase.MLB The Show 26 Release Date and Early Access Start TimesA few important things to keep in mind:Early access is exclusive to the Deluxe Edition.Players receive up to 4 days of early access before the full launch.The Deluxe Edition is digital-only.Price: $99.99 / £79.99.For comparison, the Standard Edition costs $69.99, so the early access option comes with a higher price but allows players to start several days earlier.MLB The Show 26 Early Access Release DateEarly access for MLB The Show 26 begins on March 12 at 9:00 PM PT.This allows Deluxe Edition owners to start playing before the global release window. For players planning to spend a lot of time in the game during the season, early access also provides extra time to learn the gameplay changes and begin building their teams.MLB The Show 26 Early Access Start Times (All Regions)Here is the full list of MLB The Show 26 early access start times across major time zones.Region / Time ZoneEarly Access Start TimePacific Time (PT)March 12 – 9:00 PMCentral Time (CT)March 12 – 11:00 PMEastern Time (ET)March 13 – 12:00 AMBrasilia Time (BRT)March 13 – 1:00 AMGreenwich Mean Time (GMT)March 13 – 4:00 AMCentral European Time (CET)March 13 – 5:00 AMChina Standard Time (CST)March 13 – 12:00 PMKorean Standard Time (KST)March 13 – 1:00 PMJapan Standard Time (JST)March 13 – 1:00 PMAustralian Eastern Time (AET)March 13 – 3:00 PMNew Zealand Daylight Time (NZDT)March 13 – 5:00 PMPlayers who purchased the Deluxe Edition can begin downloading and playing the game once the early access window opens in their region.
